subject: Recap + PoC intake & next steps (StratusTech / Redwood)
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@stratustech.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + proposed PoC intake & timeline (StratusTech / Redwood)

Hi Sean / Camila —

Thanks again for the call today — quick recap and a couple of asks so we can move the PoC forward: 

- Goal: Validate Redwood inference latency and cost for our customer-facing search scoring pipeline (1M monthly queries, median length ~150 tokens).
- Success criteria: 95% of requests < 250ms p95 for reranking path; per-token cost target <$0.0009.
- Data: we can provide a 10k example set + a small production manifest.
- Environment: we plan to run PoC via GCP Marketplace listing; need minimal marketplace artifacts and a test GCP project.

Next steps we discussed:
1) Technical deep-dive to go through integration points (KV cache, batching, auth, billing) — 60 min.
2) PoC intake form completed by StratusTech so Redwood can prepare an SOW and runbook.
3) Target PoC length: 2–3 weeks, with a mid-point check-in.

I attached a PoC intake template to kick things off. Could you share 2–3 slots for the technical deep-dive next week? Prefer PT mornings.

Attachment: [PoC-Intake-Form.pdf (PDF, 84KB)]

Thanks,
Amit Shah
Sr. Cloud Solutions Architect | StratusTech
amit.shah@stratustech.com | +1 (415) 555-0148

---
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@stratustech.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 May 2027 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed PoC intake & timeline (StratusTech / Redwood)

Hi Amit —

Appreciate the clear recap. This looks good and aligns with what we heard on our side. Quick responses and proposed next steps from Redwood: 

- Confirmed PoC goals and success criteria — we can target the latency and cost thresholds you outlined as the evaluation baseline.
- Camila will be the PoC lead and will own runbook + SOW draft.
- We can run the PoC end-to-end via the Marketplace flow (we'll need the test project details and a service account for the integration).

Proposed times for the technical deep-dive (60 min):
- Wed, 19 May — 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu, 20 May — 09:00–10:00 PT

Marissa — can you hold both slots on my calendar pending confirmation? If Amit confirms one, please finalize and send an invite with the meeting link.

Also attaching a brief SOW template so you have a starting point; we'll flesh in deliverables once we get the intake form back.

Attachment: [SOW-template.docx]

Amit — if you can fill the intake and share the sample manifest ahead of the deep-dive, we can prepare a short pre-read (architecture + quantization profile suggestions) to make the session productive.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Sr. Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0202
